title: HARPS-N: the new planet hunter at TNG
what_was_studied: Spectrograph architecture, environmental control, fibre scrambling and initial commissioning
numerical_result: R about 115000 over 383 to 690 nm; the table reports 0.3 m/s short-term and better than 0.6 m/s long-term precision
remaining_question: The article does not make every target or observing cadence equivalent to those instrument-level values

title: Astro-comb calibrator and spectrograph characterization using a turn-key laser frequency comb
what_was_studied: A 16 GHz comb spanning about 90 nm near 566 nm applied to HARPS-N calibration, solar spectra and detector tests
numerical_result: The comb supplied dense reference lines over a limited 90 nm band and exposed intrapixel sensitivity structure
remaining_question: Limited comb coverage and detector tests do not establish full-band stellar accuracy

title: Three years of HARPS-N high-resolution spectroscopy and precise radial velocity data for the Sun
what_was_studied: 34550 selected solar spectra reprocessed with an ESPRESSO-derived DRS and revised wavelength solution
numerical_result: Day-to-day scatter fell from 1.27 to 1.07 m/s; solar-activity correlation rose from 0.77 to 0.93
remaining_question: The remaining 1.07 m/s includes solar variability and exceeds photon and wavelength-calibration terms

title: The Extreme Stellar-Signals Project III: Combining Solar Data from HARPS HARPS-N EXPRES and NEID
what_was_studied: Contemporaneous solar velocities compared after binning to shared timestamps
numerical_result: Pairwise residual unexplained scatter was 0.15 to 0.30 m/s within the studied overlap
remaining_question: The result is an intraday comparison after time matching and does not define each instrument's multi-year floor

title: A Decade of Solar High-Fidelity Spectroscopy and Precise Radial Velocities from HARPS-N
what_was_studied: Thirteen years of wavelength solutions and a curated decade of solar observations
numerical_result: 109466 spectra remain after rejecting 30 percent; median daily RMS is 0.49 m/s and the raw 10-year RMS is 2.95 m/s
remaining_question: The 0.41 m/s long-term result follows activity modelling and is not an uncorrected instrument floor

title: TNG AOT54 submission information
what_was_studied: Current semester instrument availability and switching constraints
numerical_result: HARPS-N is listed for normal service or visitor use and unrestricted simultaneous GIARPS use
remaining_question: Availability is not a new performance measurement
